## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] Touches scraping or a live Alza route? Live-verified, with the date and result noted (PR description, `docs/live-evidence/`, or `docs/mobile-endpoint-coverage.md`)
- [ ] New tool? Assigned to exactly one toolset in `src/tools/toolsets.ts` and follows CONTRIBUTING.md → "Adding a new tool"
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry under `## [Unreleased]`
- [ ] No secrets or personal data in code, fixtures or evidence (tokens, cookies, emails, addresses, order numbers, user ids)
